description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Fire 3 with Stacking], [High Retaliate], [Damage Cap +10000], [Zenith Mode] and [Zenith Mode: Jack] to the user

description.name: Zenith Mode: Jack
description.text: Increases [Fire Infusion] damage bonus by 20%, cast speed x1.10 for PHY attacks, Fire abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Spirit Attack: Jack after using two Samurai abilities (max 1), maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Lightning Flash+
description.text: Six single attacks (1.15/1.25 each) if user hasn't/has [Retaliate] or [High Retaliate], 50% additional critical chance if user has [Retaliate] or [High Retaliate], capped at 9999/19999 after 0-2/3+ uses

description.name: Spirit Attack: Jack
description.text: Grants [Weakness +30% Boost 3] to the user/all allies with 0-3/4+ Samurai or Type-0 allies in the party

description.name: Attach Fire 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: High Retaliate
description.text: Evades PHY attacks, counters PHY attacks with an ability (PHY: single, 1.20 physical)

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
